title: Codex: dedupe character-creation 4d6-drop-lowest onto the shared F1 dice grammar
description: packages/core/src/character/abilityAllocation.ts implements its own 4d6-drop-lowest (rollAbilityScore/rollAbilityScoreSet) predating the F1 grammar. Migrate it onto dice.ts rollDice('4d6dl1') so there is exactly one keep/drop implementation (canonical rolled/kept/dropped representation from docs/dice-and-resolution.md), preserving the existing RolledAbilityScore result shape (rolls, dropped, total) and its seeded-RNG behavior contract. Mechanical, well-scoped Codex work; no behavior change intended — existing abilityAllocation tests must keep passing (update only if they pin the internal drop-selection tie order, which dice.ts defines as earliest-rolled-die-first).
acceptance_criteria: abilityAllocation.ts contains no bespoke drop-lowest selection; delegates to dice.ts; tests green.
notes: PR #451 review follow-up: fail closed on roll evidence for non-rolled methods; keep wizard on ability step when rolled evidence is missing; repair Markdown fence and stale advisory wording.
close_reason: Addressed PR #451 review: reject roll evidence for non-rolled methods, block wizard advancement without rolled evidence, repair documentation fence/semantics, and add regressions.
